verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Fivetran captures deletes and offers incremental, automated syncs without manual pipeline maintenance (fivetran-docs-13, fivetran-docs-18, fivetran-docs-35 sync modes), which is consistent with CDC-style replication, but the evidence pack never explicitly names log-based CDC, binlog, or WAL mechanisms for database connectors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of binlog/WAL-based CDC mechanism, evidence of low source-load impact, and independent/hands-on confirmation of CDC behavior for specific databases.
